title: The administration home operation, its fields, its parameter name, its entitlement rule and its record code are not in the sources
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E8-006); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P4 Access and administration v3.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3.md; 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md
description: No source names the entitlement read of the administration surface or its path, the fields of its answer, the parameter row that holds its cache lifetime, the rule that decides whether a capability area may be opened (and which areas are read-only), or the decision-record code of an open.
evidence: RWB-E8-006 gives one screen and two endpoints (POST /admin/reference-loads and POST /admin/rule-versions), both of which are other services' now; FSD P4 v3 A2.17 gives the intent, the metric, the validation rule VR-P4-017-1 and BR-P4-017 but no operation; TSD P4 v3 T-A lists API-P4-007 GET /admin/roles, API-P4-008 GET /admin/access-log and API-P4-012 GET /me/session and no entitlement or home operation; Architecture v5 slide 14 gives the P4 contract as authorise, me/permissions, doa-limits and masking-policies; DP-03 gives the local record library and its topic but not the code of a read.
proposed: Provide one read GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/home answering an AdminHome of one area row per capability area in force with capabilityArea, letters, scope and mayOpen, plus matrixVersion, maskingVersion, listVersion, roleClass, chain and recordedAt; hold the cache lifetime in the parameter row access.home.cache.ttl.seconds read through DP-06; use the library's read code for the open entry; leave the composite route and the panel lists to RWB-PLT-N001-CON.
